summary: Test suite comprehensively covers matrix generation requirements (cartesian product, exclude/include rules, feature flags, strategy options, validation, error handling) with 18 well-organized unit tests, 14 workflow structure tests, and 3 end-to-end act test cases. Uses proper Pester patterns, clear fixtures, and good helper functions. Strength: thorough unit and structure testing; validates exact output values and error messages; reproduces canonical GitHub Actions example. Weakness: limited to 3 end-to-end act test cases covering only happy paths—missing error scenario validation through act (invalid JSON, missing config, empty matrices), CLI fallback logic (MATRIX_CONFIG_PATH env var), and some edge cases (empty dimension arrays, special characters). Would catch most regressions in core logic but lacks depth for end-to-end robustness.
